messages:
marta: Putting a proposal on the table: gated canary for the routing-fallback rollout. goal: minimize blast radius and have measurable contract checks before each traffic bump. want explicit canary gates + auto-throttle, and a quick manual kill switch.
sean: sounds good. suggest we require three gate types: 1) infra health (errors/latency), 2) quality (paired evals), 3) cost delta. each gate must pass for 30m before next bump.
jess: for quality gating I want A/B significance on a 1k prompt paired set per step. metric: top1 accuracy and response shard-coverage. use bootstrap CIs and require p < 0.05 for acceptance.
rishi: operationally: traffic plan should be small-to-large slices: dev-only 3%, early-beta 7%, invited-customers 20%, prod-slice 35% -> full. min dwell 24h, except we can hold longer if any gate is flaky.
emily: ops notes: dashboards needed for each slice (error rate, p95/p99 latency, fallback counts, cache-hit-rate). enable 7d log retention for canary users and increase sampling of traces to 100% for the first 6h after each bump.
marta: draft flag schema we can push to toggle behavior quickly (minimal semantics):
```yaml
flag: routing_fallback_gate
variants:
  - name: control
    fallback: none
  - name: staged_fallback
    steps: [dev, beta, invited, prodslice]
gates:
  - infra_health: {max_5m_error_rate: 0.5%}
  - latency_p95_ms: 450
  - quality_top1_drop_pct: -1.0
rollback_policy: auto_throttle_or_disable
```
sean: add automated rollback criteria: if error_rate > 3x baseline for 15m OR latency_p99 > threshold for 10m -> throttle to previous step and page on-call. Also track cost-per-request delta > +40% -> hold.
jess: test harness: run old vs new in parallel for all canary traffic (shadow + pair logging). keep a running daily report and post results to #product-canaries. I'll own the analysis pipeline.
emily: we'll add a synthetic user flow that exercises routing and KV cache. Script: `scripts/synth_route_check.py --region $REGION` to run every 2m. set alerts: synth-failures > 3 in 15m -> page.
rishi: deploy-bot: scheduling proposal: NA canary start 2026-05-05 10:00 PDT (48h), EU start 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC (48h), APAC hold until NA+EU clear. canary checklist posted. :spiral_calendar_pad:
deploy-bot: canary checklist items -> flag deployed, metric pipelines enabled, paired logging active, paired-eval job scheduled, rollback hooks present. run `./bin/canary-check` preflight.
marta: decision anchors for go/no-go: no gate failures in 48h, paired A/B top1 delta within -1% absolute, p95 within 10% of baseline, no sustained error spikes, cost delta below 25%. if any anchor fails -> hold and triage.
sean: agree. I'll produce an automated slide with gate outputs and an SLA impact summary before shiproom.
jess: I'll add the hypothesis and acceptance notes to the product PR and include the paired dataset id. will also add an 'unsafe' label to block auto-promote if tests fail.
emily: ops will pre-create dashboards, increase log retention for the canary cohort, and temp-enable debug logs for the fallback path.
marta: OK — owners: @sean (metrics + A/B), @jess (datasets + tests), @emily (ops + dashboards), @rishi (deploy choreography). scheduling shiproom 24h before public ramp. tagging this thread as the rollout source of truth. :white_check_mark:
